newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mexico to issue 1 bln dmk, 12 yr Eurobond Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to issue 1 bln dmk, 12 yr Eurobond Tuesday.

text.p: The state of Mexico plans to issue a mark-denominated Eurobond on Tuesday with a volume of one billion marks ($609.3 million) and a maturity of 12 years, finance minister Guillermo Ortiz told reporters at a presentation in Frankfurt on Monday.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson are joint lead managers for the issue.
Mexico to issue 1 bln dmk, 12 yr Eurobond Tuesday
Ortiz said proceeds from the bond sale would be used to finance short-term Mexican liabilities.
Banking sources said the bond would yield 260 to 280 basis points over the new German 10-year, six-percent government bond.
